header: The small pieces the calculator forms share: the privacy and approximation notice, a labelled field, a stat card, a bar of two parts. They are plain and accessible, and keep no state of their own.

symbols.name: ToolNotice
symbols.sig: export function ToolNotice({ rates }: { rates?: boolean | string })
doc: I say this on every calculator: nothing typed is kept, and the result is an approximation.
